newsitem.title: USA: Baker Hughes to pay $54.4 mln for Deutz unit.
newsitem.headline: Baker Hughes to pay $54.4 mln for Deutz unit.

text.p: Baker Hughes Inc said on Tuesday it would pay $54.4 million to purchase the environmental technology division of Germany's Deutz AG.
Deutz said yesterday that it would sell the business but did not disclose a price.
The division comprises the decanter centrifuge business of Deutz's subsidiary, KHD Humboldt Wedag AG, and the filter press and dryer businesses of Rittershaus & Blecher GmbH.
"Baker Hughes desires to acquire the business to complement the centrifuge and filter product lines of Baker Hughes' Bird Machine Company division," Baker Hughes said.
The companies aim to close the deal, which is subject to German Federal Cartel Office, on July 1.

Baker Hughes' main business is providing services to the oil industry, while Deutz emerged from the wreckage of the Kloeckner-Humboldt-Deutz empire and has been selling assets outside its core motor business since that date.
Baker Hughes meanwhile has been diversifying its business through pacts and acquisitions. ((--New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
